sentences.en: This ship is too big to pass through the canal.
sentences.zh: 这艘船太大了，无法通过运河。

sentences.en: The completion of the Suez canal was a colossal achievement.
sentences.zh: 苏伊士运河的完工是一项巨大的成就。

sentences.en: A river and a canal are both types of waterway.
sentences.zh: 河流和运河都是水道的一种。

senses.zh: 运河；[地理] 水道；[建] 管道；灌溉水渠
